notes: CT-6 builds on closed uncommitted CT-4 and CT-5 candidates; review must isolate the active target paths and semantics.

Independent review recorded two High and one Medium findings; duplicate anchors, foreign Behavior snapshots, and real reversed-input determinism are now Fixed and focused-verified.
The declared final gate passed. CT-6 is closed.

Post-closure external regeneration succeeded after command permission was restored. Six configured roots plus two HTTP roots generated eight diagrams with 97 Mermaid messages versus two messages in the stale Web-only output. Each Web diagram increased from one to six messages and SC013 fell from 16 to 11.

The external run also exposed 92 conservative SC-DIRECT-MISMATCH boundaries across configured roots. Root-local diagrams are materially useful, but same-project child-body expansion is largely withheld; this measured generic mismatch requires diagnosis before cross-project traversal is the highest-value next implementation.
